component.name: Legion Light
component.summary: Keyboard backlight control in the GNOME top bar for Lenovo Legion laptops

description.p: Legion Light for GNOME puts the keyboard backlight of Lenovo Legion laptops with a one-zone RGB keyboard in the GNOME top bar. Its settings dialog edits the three Fn+Space profiles, effects, colours, custom palettes and brightness.
A background service fades the backlight down after a period without input and brings it back as soon as you return. Custom palettes and random blends keep playing with no window open.
Open Legion Light once after installing to add the GNOME Shell extension, then log out and back in. Device access needs a udev rule installed on the host; see the project page.
